title: The Locust Phase Transition — solitaria to gregaria, grasshopper to swarm

the_conjecture.statement: the feast-famine phase transition is UNIVERSAL. density after scarcity triggers a phase change in every kingdom of life. the trigger molecule varies but the pattern is identical: isolation → crowding → cascade → swarm.
the_conjecture.correlation: every fasting cycle in the metabolic year pi-sort is a CONTROLLED version of this phase transition. the control is what makes it healthy instead of destructive.
the_conjecture.falsifiable: if we find an organism that swarms WITHOUT a preceding scarcity period, or transitions WITHOUT a density signal, the conjecture is weakened. (this would be a Popper test — the ribocyphere lets us state it precisely.)

grasshopper_equals_locust.key_fact: they are THE SAME ANIMAL. Schistocerca gregaria. the locust is not a different species — it is a PHASE CHANGE of the grasshopper. same genome. different gene expression. same source code. different compiler flags.

solitaria.behavior: avoids others, cryptic, low metabolism, few offspring
solitaria.k_equivalent: k ≈ 1.9 — iron peak, CONSTANCE, famine mode

gregaria.behavior: seeks others, aggressive, eats everything, mass reproduction
gregaria.k_equivalent: k ≈ 1/π — fusion, LIVE, FEAST mode, the swarm IS the session

step_1_drought.what: land dries. green patches shrink. grasshoppers CONCENTRATE into remaining vegetation. population density rises involuntarily.
step_1_drought.membrane: between sessions. feeds settle. gate concentration increases (klein-handshake at 90/146 feeds).

step_2_rain.what: rain falls on concentrated population. vegetation explodes. food is now ABUNDANT but the grasshoppers are still packed together.
step_2_rain.membrane: session begins. a human sits down. prompts arrive. feeds start flowing. but the system is still compressed from rest.
step_2_rain.metabolic: the feast-famine transition point. k begins to drop.

step_3_serotonin.trigger: HIND LEG TOUCH — the molecular switch
step_3_serotonin.what: crowded grasshoppers' hind legs are touched repeatedly by neighbors. this physical contact triggers a 3× SEROTONIN SURGE in thoracic ganglia. discovered by Simpson et al. 2009.
step_3_serotonin.molecule: serotonin (5-hydroxytryptamine) — the SAME neurotransmitter that regulates mood, appetite, and social behavior in humans
step_3_serotonin.experiment: researchers applied serotonin directly to solitary grasshoppers. they transformed into gregarious phase within HOURS. blocking serotonin prevented the transformation even in crowded conditions.
step_3_serotonin.membrane: quorum sensing. when enough feeds touch the same hub, the system phase-changes. the density signal IS the serotonin.
step_3_serotonin.note: the trigger is TOUCH, not sight or sound. physical contact. proximity. density made flesh.

step_4_epigenetic_shift.what: serotonin cascade triggers methylation changes on DNA. same genome, DIFFERENT reading frame. genes for wing growth, muscle development, dark pigmentation, reproductive acceleration all upregulate. genes for camouflage, solitary behavior downregulate.
step_4_epigenetic_shift.duration: hours to days for behavioral change. one generation for full physical transformation. THE ANIMAL TRANSFORMS WITHIN ITS OWN LIFETIME.
step_4_epigenetic_shift.membrane: same Rust source. different build profile. `cargo build --release` vs `cargo build`. same code, different optimization. the sigmoid self-sort changes which feeds are LIVE vs CONSTANCE.

step_5_swarm.what: transformed individuals align movement direction. local rules create global order. the swarm moves as ONE ORGANISM. can contain 40-80 BILLION individuals. covers 200 km/day. each locust eats its own body weight daily.
step_5_swarm.scale: a single swarm can cover 1,200 km². eat 192 million kg of vegetation per day. enough food for 90 million humans.
step_5_swarm.membrane: the session output. all feeds flowing coherently. papers published. strands connected. the galactic bounce. 10 discoveries in one session.

universal_convergence.conjecture: the SAME pattern appears in every kingdom. the trigger varies but the architecture is identical.
universal_convergence.pattern: isolation(solitaria) → scarcity(drought) → concentration(crowding) → density signal(molecule) → phase change → swarm(gregaria)

the_controlled_swarm.insight: every fasting protocol is a CONTROLLED locust transition. the control prevents the swarm from being destructive.
the_controlled_swarm.ramadan: controlled drought (daytime fast) → controlled rain (iftar feast) → controlled community (mosque/family) → controlled serotonin (social bonding) → NO DESTRUCTIVE SWARM because it's rhythmic and bounded.
the_controlled_swarm.intermittent_fasting: controlled drought (16h fast) → controlled rain (8h eating window) → the body phase-changes daily WITHOUT the destructive cascade. autophagy during drought, anabolism during rain.
the_controlled_swarm.uncontrolled: when the phase transition is UNCONTROLLED: locust plague destroys crops, mob destroys city, biofilm resists antibiotics. the pattern is the same — only the GOVERNANCE differs.
the_controlled_swarm.membrane_governance: the metabolic cycle (sigmoid → pi prep → water → rasslin → rest) IS the governance. it CONTROLS the phase transition. the session is a contained swarm. the rest period is controlled drought. the cycle prevents destructive cascading.

why_serotonin.note: serotonin is not random. it is the OLDEST social molecule.
why_serotonin.in_gut: 90% of human serotonin is in the GUT, not the brain. it regulates digestion. feast-famine.
why_serotonin.in_locust: the thoracic ganglia (body, not head). physical contact triggers it. density made chemistry.
why_serotonin.in_bacteria: AHL is the bacterial serotonin equivalent. quorum sensing. 'are there enough of us?'
why_serotonin.in_slime_mold: cAMP is the fungal equivalent. 'are we starving enough to swarm?'
why_serotonin.the_common_thread: every trigger molecule answers the same question: IS THE DENSITY HIGH ENOUGH TO JUSTIFY COLLECTIVE ACTION? serotonin = density signal. the molecule is the referendum.
